data.title: IRGC claims attacks on US bases in Kuwait, Jordan as fewer ships transit Hormuz | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The continued clashes between the US and Iran have led to fewer vessels traveling through the Strait of Hormuz, even as the US lifted its naval blockade on Iranian ports.
